children: Nutanix, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results showing revenue of $2.85B, up 12% from $2.54B a year earlier, and net income of $1.51B versus $188.4M in FY2025. Diluted earnings per share rose to $5.17 from $0.65 in the prior year.
Revenue was $2,853.5M for FY2026, compared with $2,537.9M in FY2025; YoY change 12%.
Net income was $1,506.8M for FY2026, versus $188.4M in FY2025.
Diluted earnings per share was $5.17 for FY2026, up from $0.65 in FY2025.
Total revenue growth was driven by subscription and renewal expansion; annual recurring revenue (ARR) rose to $2.55B.
Channel and fulfillment strategy shifted further toward partner/OEM-led sales and enabled software-only purchases separate from hardware to mitigate supply delays.
Product momentum included expansion of the Nutanix Cloud Platform into cloud-native and enterprise AI (agentic AI) workloads.
Operational scale and efficiency improved, with operating margin expanding to 9.6% alongside continued investments in go-to-market and R&D while prioritizing productivity.
Customer traction remained solid with more than 32,000 end customers and net revenue retention (NRR) of 106%, indicating retention and expansion across industries.
